propositions: A Backend facade with five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be defined to allow multiple backends to implement the reconciler interface
JiraBackend must wrap existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields, comment_limits) as a thin delegation shim with zero behavior change
IdentityConvention must provide a pure convention object to format RemoteRef to rebar-id label strings and parse them back, consolidating the currently inlined four-site pattern

A backend-agnostic contract test suite must verify outbound-to-inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotence, identity round-trips, and capability-guarded dispatch via isinstance checks without structural introspection
Capability detection must use @runtime_checkable Protocol isinstance checks exclusively; backends advertise capabilities by inheriting optional Protocols, not via a capabilities() method
No core differ/apply/applier call sites are rewired in this story; the Backend port and JiraBackend implementation are pure additions
